<script>
(() => {
  const element = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const clamp = x => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  const mix = (a, b, u) => a + (b - a) * u;
  const translate = (x, y) => `translate(${x} ${y})`;
  const transform = (id, value) => element(id).setAttribute("transform", value);
  const move = (id, x, y) => transform(id, translate(x, y));
  const light = (id, x, y) => element(id).setAttribute("gradientTransform", translate(x, y));
  const numberPattern = /-?(?:\d*\.)?\d+/g;
  const coordinates = d => d.match(numberPattern).map(Number);

  // Keep the drawing coordinates immutable so every seek starts from the same pose.
  function deformable(id) {
    const path = element(id);
    const original = path.getAttribute("d");
    const points = coordinates(original);
    return function deform(mapping) {
      const result = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i += 2) {
        result.push(...mapping(points[i], points[i + 1], i));
      }
      let index = 0;
      path.setAttribute("d", original.replace(numberPattern, () => " " + result[index++].toFixed(3)));
    };
  }

  const leftBody = deformable("left-shape");
  const rightBody = deformable("right-shape");
  const sleeve = deformable("writing-sleeve");
  const farSleeve = deformable("left-far-sleeve-shape");
  const farSleeveLight = deformable("left-far-sleeve-light");
  const shoulderArm = deformable("right-far-sleeve");
  const reaching = ["near-arm-shape", "reach-underside", "reach-highlight"].map(deformable);
  const mouth = deformable("left-mouth-opening");
  const lowerLip = deformable("left-lower-lip");

  const upright = coordinates(
    "M-10 116C-7 101 2 87 8.5 74.5C15 60 20 48.6 31.5 41.3" +
    "C38 37.3 47.7 34.5 56 35.1C68.5 35.4 77.7 40.8 82.6 49.5" +
    "C86.3 55.8 85.3 66.4 84.4 73C84 77.6 87.3 78.3 87.1 81.1" +
    "C85.7 87 78.6 93.8 84.5 99.7C94.7 109.6 103.7 123.8 111.6 141" +
    "L118 193C102 196 82.8 195.5 73 198L67 201C53 198.1 40 199.8 30 201.1L-6 206Z"
  );
  const openMouth = coordinates(
    "M0 0C3.8 -2.2 10 -3.5 14.8 -3.1C16.5 -2.9 17.4 -1.9 17.8 -1.1" +
    "C14.1 -.6 10 .4 6.2 .9C2.8 1.6 .8 1.1 0 0Z"
  );
  const openLip = coordinates("M.8 .8Q8.3 1.2 17.8 -.5Q13.2 2.3 4.1 2.5Z");

  function slope(a, b) {
    return a * b > 0 ? 2 * a * b / (a + b) : 0;
  }

  function render(t) {
    const ms = ((t % 1500) + 1500) % 1500;
    const i = Math.min(6, Math.floor(ms / 200));
    const u = clamp(ms / 200 - i);
    const u2 = u * u;
    const u3 = u2 * u;
    function sample(values) {
      const a = values[i], b = values[i + 1], d = b - a;
      const m = i === 0 ? d : slope(a - values[i - 1], d);
      const n = i === 6 ? 0 : slope(d, values[i + 2] - b);
      return a + (3 * u2 - 2 * u3) * d + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m + (u3 - u2) * n;
    }

    const lift = sample([0, .15, .28, .65, .84, .96, 1, 1]);
    const turn = sample([0, .035, .12, .7, .92, 1, 1, 1]);
    const sway = sample([0, -2.2, -1.9, -.8, -.8, -.2, 0, 0]);
    leftBody((x, y, j) => [
      mix(x, upright[j], lift) + sway * clamp((165 - y) / 62),
      mix(y, upright[j + 1], lift)
    ]);

    const crownX = -8 * lift + sway, crownY = -16.6 * lift;
    move("left-head-light", crownX, crownY);
    light("left-crown", crownX, crownY);
    light("head-fade-left", 0, crownY);
    light("left-coat", -6 * lift, -12 * lift);

    const bellyRise = sample([0, 7.6, 9.2, 13.7, 16.8, 19.8, 20.7, 20.7]);
    transform("left-belly-patch",
      `${translate(-.23 * bellyRise, 201)} scale(${1 + .0028 * bellyRise} ${1 + bellyRise / 59}) translate(0 -201)`);

    const nearEyeX = sample([52, 49.1, 50.1, 60.6, 63.2, 62.7, 62.3, 62.3]);
    const nearEyeY = sample([89.4, 85.7, 83.3, 73.3, 67.8, 64.2, 63.5, 63.5]);
    transform("left-outer-eye",
      `${translate(nearEyeX, nearEyeY)} rotate(${-22 * turn}) scale(1 ${1 + .035 * turn}) translate(-52 -89.4)`);
    move("left-near-pupil", .6 * turn, -1.7 * turn);

    const farEyeX = sample([91.4, 87.8, 88.2, 90.3, 87.3, 84.3, 83.9, 83.9]);
    const farEyeY = sample([93.4, 87.8, 85.1, 68.8, 63.8, 60.2, 59.3, 59.3]);
    const farWidth = sample([1, 1, .96, .52, .38, .31, .3, .3]);
    transform("left-inner-eye",
      `${translate(farEyeX, farEyeY)} scale(${farWidth} ${1 - .24 * turn}) rotate(${-12 * turn}) translate(-91.4 -93.4)`);
    transform("left-far-pupil", `${translate(.7 * turn, -2.2 * turn)} rotate(19 92.9 96.8)`);

    const mouthX = sample([62.1, 55.1, 55.9, 68.1, 70.1, 69.6, 69.5, 69.5]);
    const mouthY = sample([108.7, 103.4, 101.3, 92.9, 86.8, 82.5, 81.7, 81.7]);
    move("left-mouth", mouthX, mouthY);
    mouth((x, y, j) => [mix(x, openMouth[j], turn), mix(y, openMouth[j + 1], turn)]);
    lowerLip((x, y, j) => [mix(x, openLip[j], turn), mix(y, openLip[j + 1], turn)]);
    const darkness = sample([0, .24, .42, .92, 1, 1, 1, 1]);

    "M0 0C3.8 -2.2 10 -3.5 14.8 -3.1C16.5 -2.9 17.4 -1.9 17.8 -1.1" +
    "C14.1 -.6 10 .4 6.2 .9C2.8 1.6 .8 1.1 0 0Z"
  );
  const openLip = coordinates("M.8 .8Q8.3 1.2 17.8 -.5Q13.2 2.3 4.1 2.5Z");

  function slope(a, b) {
    return a * b > 0 ? 2 * a * b / (a + b) : 0;
  }

  function render(t) {
    const ms = ((t % 1500) + 1500) % 1500;
    const i = Math.min(6, Math.floor(ms / 200));
    const u = clamp(ms / 200 - i);
    const u2 = u * u;
    const u3 = u2 * u;
    function sample(values) {
      const a = values[i], b = values[i + 1], d = b - a;
      const m = i === 0 ? d : slope(a - values[i - 1], d);
      const n = i === 6 ? 0 : slope(d, values[i + 2] - b);
      return a + (3 * u2 - 2 * u3) * d + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m + (u3 - u2) * n;
    }

    const lift = sample([0, .15, .28, .65, .84, .96, 1, 1]);
    const turn = sample([0, .035, .12, .7, .92, 1, 1, 1]);
    const sway = sample([0, -2.2, -1.9, -.8, -.8, -.2, 0, 0]);
    leftBody((x, y, j) => [
      mix(x, upright[j], lift) + sway * clamp((165 - y) / 62),
      mix(y, upright[j + 1], lift)
    ]);

    const crownX = -8 * lift + sway, crownY = -16.6 * lift;
    move("left-head-light", crownX, crownY);
    light("left-crown", crownX, crownY);
    light("head-fade-left", 0, crownY);
    light("left-coat", -6 * lift, -12 * lift);

    const bellyRise = sample([0, 7.6, 9.2, 13.7, 16.8, 19.8, 20.7, 20.7]);
    transform("left-belly-patch",
      `${translate(-.23 * bellyRise, 201)} scale(${1 + .0028 * bellyRise} ${1 + bellyRise / 59}) translate(0 -201)`);

    const nearEyeX = sample([52, 49.1, 50.1, 60.6, 63.2, 62.7, 62.3, 62.3]);
    const nearEyeY = sample([89.4, 85.7, 83.3, 73.3, 67.8, 64.2, 63.5, 63.5]);
    transform("left-outer-eye",
      `${translate(nearEyeX, nearEyeY)} rotate(${-22 * turn}) scale(1 ${1 + .035 * turn}) translate(-52 -89.4)`);
    move("left-near-pupil", .6 * turn, -1.7 * turn);

    const farEyeX = sample([91.4, 87.8, 88.2, 90.3, 87.3, 84.3, 83.9, 83.9]);
    const farEyeY = sample([93.4, 87.8, 85.1, 68.8, 63.8, 60.2, 59.3, 59.3]);
    const farWidth = sample([1, 1, .96, .52, .38, .31, .3, .3]);
    transform("left-inner-eye",
      `${translate(farEyeX, farEyeY)} scale(${farWidth} ${1 - .24 * turn}) rotate(${-12 * turn}) translate(-91.4 -93.4)`);
    transform("left-far-pupil", `${translate(.7 * turn, -2.2 * turn)} rotate(19 92.9 96.8)`);

    const mouthX = sample([62.1, 55.1, 55.9, 68.1, 70.1, 69.6, 69.5, 69.5]);
    const mouthY = sample([108.7, 103.4, 101.3, 92.9, 86.8, 82.5, 81.7, 81.7]);
    move("left-mouth", mouthX, mouthY);
    mouth((x, y, j) => [mix(x, openMouth[j], turn), mix(y, openMouth[j + 1], turn)]);
    lowerLip((x, y, j) => [mix(x, openLip[j], turn), mix(y, openLip[j + 1], turn)]);
    const darkness = sample([0, .24, .42, .92, 1, 1, 1, 1]);
    const opening = element("left-mouth-opening");
    opening.setAttribute("fill", darkness === 0 ? "url(#left-mouth-color)" :
      `rgb(${Math.round(mix(129, 36, darkness))},${Math.round(mix(82, 25, darkness))},${Math.round(mix(30, 13, darkness))})`);

    const farArmShift = (x, y) => {
      const shoulder = clamp((193 - y) / 80);
      return [x - lift * (2 + 8 * shoulder) + sway * shoulder, y - lift * (3.3 + 14.4 * shoulder)];
    };
    farSleeve(farArmShift);
    farSleeveLight(farArmShift);
    move("left-resting-hand", -2 * lift, -3.3 * lift);
    light("left-far-sleeve", -7 * lift, -13 * lift);

    const writingX = sample([0, -5.8, -12.6, -19.4, -23.1, -25.9, -26.6, -26.6]);
    const writingY = sample([0, -1.2, -3.4, -7.1, -8.4, -9, -9.2, -9.2]);
    sleeve((x, y) => {
      const wrist = clamp((y - 112) / 80);
      return [x + mix(-10 * lift + sway, writingX, wrist), y + mix(-18 * lift, writingY, wrist)];
    });
    light("writing-arm", writingX * .8, writingY);
    move("writing-wrist", writingX, writingY);
    transform("pencil-in-hand", `rotate(${sample([0, -9, -12, -17.5, -19.5, -21, -21.5, -21.5])} 38 198)`);
    transform("left-writing-hand", `rotate(${-7 * lift} 35 202)`);

    const topX = sample([0, -6.9, -6.4, -6.1, -5.6, -4.8, -4.2, -4.2]);
    const topY = sample([0, 2.4, 1.9, 1.6, .8, -.8, -1.5, -1.5]);
    const faceX = sample([0, -8.4, -8.1, -8.1, -8.3, -8.2, -7.8, -7.8]);
    const faceY = sample([0, 3.5, 3.1, 2.1, .1, -2.6, -3.7, -3.7]);

    rightBody((x, y) => {
      const face = clamp((y - 43) / 25);
      const weight = clamp((193 - y) / 84) * clamp((244 - x) / 58);
      return [x + weight * mix(topX, faceX, face), y + weight * mix(topY, faceY, face)];
    });
    move("right-head-light", topX, topY);
    light("right-crown", topX, topY);
    light("head-fade-right", 0, faceY);
    move("right-eyes", faceX, faceY);
    move("right-near-pupil", -.6 * turn, -.5 * turn);
    const rightMouthX = sample([0, -8.4, -8.4, -8.1, -7.9, -7, -6.6, -6.6]);
    const rightMouthY = sample([0, 3.8, 3.7, 2.9, 1.6, -1.8, -2.7, -2.7]);
    transform("right-mouth",
      `${translate(120.9 + rightMouthX, 88 + rightMouthY)} scale(${1 - .14 * turn} 1) translate(-120.9 -88)`);

    const shoulderX = sample([0, -3.9, -5.1, -9.5, -11.7, -13.4, -13.6, -13.6]);
    const shoulderY = sample([0, -4.4, -7.3, -11, -12.2, -12.8, -12.8, -12.8]);
    move("right-far-hand", shoulderX, shoulderY);
    shoulderArm((x, y) => {
      const w = clamp((137 - x) / 33);
      return [x + mix(faceX * .85, shoulderX, w), y + mix(faceY * .45, shoulderY, w)];
    });
    light("right-back-arm", shoulderX * .8, shoulderY * .8);

    const handX = sample([0, -6.8, -17.8, -12.4, -14.9, -17, -11.3, -14.3]);
    const handY = sample([0, -3.1, 3.6, -3.6, -3.8, -.5, -5.8, -4.1]);
    const handAngle = sample([0, 7, 4, 6, 6, 5, 6.5, 6]);
    transform("right-reaching-hand", `${translate(handX, handY)} rotate(${handAngle} 114 170)`);
    move("palm-contact-shadow", handX, handY);
    const armShift = (x, y) => {
      const wrist = clamp((197 - x) / 80);
      const upper = (1 - wrist) * clamp((161 - y) / 50);
      return [
        x + wrist * handX + faceX * upper * .34,
        y + wrist * handY + faceY * upper * .32 - 4.4 * lift * Math.sin(Math.PI * wrist)
      ];
    };
    for (const part of reaching) part(armShift);
    light("arm-tip-shade", handX, handY);
    light("arm-fade", handX * .6, handY * .5);
  }

  window.nwb = {render};
  render(0);
})();
</script>
